title: Onboarding Blocks
summary: 28 new onboarding blocks covering welcome screens, multi step wizards, workspace setup, activation checklists and finish screens, with an upgraded onboarding page plan for the MCP server.
body:
Added a full set of onboarding blocks, available under **Blocks** in five new docs pages: Onboarding - Welcome, Wizard, Workspace Setup, Checklist and Completion. Every block takes typed props, keeps its own state and uses fictional sample content, and each one has a skip or dismiss action so you never trap a new user.

#### Welcome

- Quick start actions, a product tour with progress dots, role and use case pickers built from radio groups and checkboxes, a plan picker with a yearly switch and a personalised welcome banner with a setup ring

#### Wizard

- Horizontal and vertical steppers, a full height sidebar wizard with a progress bar, a vee-validate multi step form with a schema per step, a review and confirm step and a wizard in a dialog

#### Workspace setup

- Create a workspace with an auto filled URL, upload a logo and pick a brand color with a live preview, invite teammates with email chips, connect integrations, import a CSV with column mapping and choose notification preferences

#### Checklist

- Getting started card, progress ring with tasks, a collapsible setup widget, a milestone trail with rewards, a tip carousel and a dismissible setup banner

#### Completion

- An all set screen, a celebration with a recap, a next steps grid and an invite and finish form. No confetti, and the one animated check respects reduced motion

#### MCP

- The `onboarding` page plan now pulls welcome, wizard, workspace setup, checklist and finish blocks from the new categories
- Block docs links and search keywords cover the five new categories
